## Examine Founder Event Effects in Introduced Populatinos of EUVI

Read in the data and generate a genind object. 

```{r}
EUVI <- read.vcfR("populations.snps.thinned.1SD-removed.noLAFI.maf0.01.NoExHet.recode.vcf")
EUVI.gid <- vcfR2genind(EUVI)

site_history <- read.csv("EUVI_site_history - Sheet1.csv")
site_history$site <- site_history$Sample_abbr
#site_history <- dplyr::select(site_history, Sample_abbr, Rank, Certainty, Release_year)

popmap3 <- read.delim("samples_to_keep.txt", sep = " ")
colnames(popmap3) <- c("sample", "site", "geog1", "geog2")

popmap <- full_join(popmap3, site_history, by = "site")
#write.csv(file="popmap_sitehistory.csv", popmap, quote = F, row.names = F)

popmap <- read.csv("popmap_sitehistory.csv")

# Make dataframe linking groupings to site history: 

history <- c("Primary", "Turkey", "Greece", "PNW", "P/S", "P/S", "S/T", "S/T", "S/T", "S/T/Q", "S/T/Q", "T/Q", "T/Q", "T/Q", "T/Q", "T/Q", "T/Q", "S/T", "S/T")
grouping <- c("Primary", "Turkey", "Greece", "PNW", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F1", "F2", "G1", "G2", "H", "I1", "I2", "WA", "OR", "ID")
key_df <- data.frame(history, grouping)

```

In the next block, we will subset the overall genind to only include the candidate loci identified by the pRDA in the introduced range. 

```{r}
full_candidates <- read.delim("full_candidate_list.txt", sep = " ")

pRDA.WUS <- full_candidates %>% select(locus, pRDA.WUS) %>%  na.omit() %>% select(locus)

all_loci <- locNames(EUVI.gid)
all_loci <- gsub("X", "", all_loci)
test <- gsub("\\:[0-9]*","", all_loci)

locNames(EUVI.gid) <- test
pRDA.WUS.loci <- as.character(pRDA.WUS$locus)

non_cand_loci <- setdiff(test, pRDA.WUS.loci)

EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid <- EUVI.gid[loc = pRDA.WUS.loci]
EUVI.notCand.gid <- EUVI.gid[loc = non_cand_loci]


# EU pRDA candidates: 
pRDA.EU <- full_candidates %>% dplyr::select(locus, pRDA.EU) %>% na.omit() %>% dplyr::select(locus)

pRDA.EU.loci <- as.character(pRDA.EU$locus)

EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid <- EUVI.gid[loc = pRDA.EU.loci]
```

Get some basic stats across population groupings. 

Here, I consider all the samples within each geographic region (Greece, Turkey, NCA, SCA, and PNW) to be in the same population, so we can a single point estimate for each geographic region. 

```{r}
se <- function(x) sd(x, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(x))

pop(EUVI.gid) <- popmap$Grouping
#EUVI.gid

pop(EUVI.notCand.gid) <- popmap$Grouping

pop(EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid) <- popmap$Grouping
#EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid

pop(EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid) <- popmap$Grouping

# Expected heterozygosity at population-level 
notCand.BS <- basic.stats(EUVI.notCand.gid)
WUSCand.BS <- basic.stats(EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid)
EUCand.BS <- basic.stats(EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid)

# Non candidate
He <- as.data.frame(notCand.BS$Hs)
se(He$Turkey); se(He$Greece); se(He$F1); se(He$OR); se(He$I2); se(He$WA); se(He$E); se(He$D); se(He$F2); se(He$Primary); se(He$B); se(He$C); se(He$C); se(He$H); se(He$G2); se(He$I1); se(He$G1); se(He$A)

Ho <- as.data.frame(notCand.BS$Ho)
se(Ho$Turkey); se(Ho$Greece); se(Ho$F1); se(Ho$OR); se(Ho$I2); se(Ho$WA); se(Ho$E); se(Ho$D); se(Ho$F2); se(Ho$Primary); se(Ho$B); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$H); se(Ho$G2); se(Ho$I1); se(Ho$G1); se(Ho$A)

Fis <- as.data.frame(notCand.BS$Fis)
se(Fis$Turkey); se(Fis$Greece); se(Fis$F1); se(Fis$OR); se(Fis$I2); se(Fis$WA); se(Fis$E); se(Fis$D); se(Fis$F2); se(Fis$Primary); se(Fis$B); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$H); se(Fis$G2); se(Fis$I1); se(Fis$G1); se(Fis$A)

# WUS Candidates
He <- as.data.frame(WUSCand.BS$Hs)
se(He$Turkey); se(He$Greece); se(He$F1); se(He$OR); se(He$I2); se(He$WA); se(He$E); se(He$D); se(He$F2); se(He$Primary); se(He$B); se(He$C); se(He$C); se(He$H); se(He$G2); se(He$I1); se(He$G1); se(He$A)

Ho <- as.data.frame(WUSCand.BS$Ho)
se(Ho$Turkey); se(Ho$Greece); se(Ho$F1); se(Ho$OR); se(Ho$I2); se(Ho$WA); se(Ho$E); se(Ho$D); se(Ho$F2); se(Ho$Primary); se(Ho$B); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$H); se(Ho$G2); se(Ho$I1); se(Ho$G1); se(Ho$A)

Fis <- as.data.frame(WUSCand.BS$Fis)
se(Fis$Turkey); se(Fis$Greece); se(Fis$F1); se(Fis$OR); se(Fis$I2); se(Fis$WA); se(Fis$E); se(Fis$D); se(Fis$F2); se(Fis$Primary); se(Fis$B); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$H); se(Fis$G2); se(Fis$I1); se(Fis$G1); se(Fis$A)

#EU Candidates
He <- as.data.frame(EUCand.BS$Hs)
se(He$Turkey); se(He$Greece); se(He$F1); se(He$OR); se(He$I2); se(He$WA); se(He$E); se(He$D); se(He$F2); se(He$Primary); se(He$B); se(He$C); se(He$C); se(He$H); se(He$G2); se(He$I1); se(He$G1); se(He$A)

Ho <- as.data.frame(EUCand.BS$Ho)
se(Ho$Turkey); se(Ho$Greece); se(Ho$F1); se(Ho$OR); se(Ho$I2); se(Ho$WA); se(Ho$E); se(Ho$D); se(Ho$F2); se(Ho$Primary); se(Ho$B); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$C); se(Ho$H); se(Ho$G2); se(Ho$I1); se(Ho$G1); se(Ho$A)

Fis <- as.data.frame(EUCand.BS$Fis)
se(Fis$Turkey); se(Fis$Greece); se(Fis$F1); se(Fis$OR); se(Fis$I2); se(Fis$WA); se(Fis$E); se(Fis$D); se(Fis$F2); se(Fis$Primary); se(Fis$B); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$C); se(Fis$H); se(Fis$G2); se(Fis$I1); se(Fis$G1); se(Fis$A)

He_pop <- Hs(data = EUVI.notCand.gid)

He_pop_cand <- Hs(data = EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid)

He_pop_EUcand <- Hs(data = EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid)

# Observed heterozygosity at population-level 
Ho_pop <- Ho(data = EUVI.notCand.gid)

Ho_pop_cand <- Ho(data  = EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid)

Ho_pop_EUcand <- Ho(data = EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid)

# Get Fis at population level 
Fis_pop <- 1-(Ho_pop/He_pop)

Fis_pop_cand <- 1-(Ho_pop_cand/He_pop_cand)

Fis_pop_EUcand <- 1-(Ho_pop_EUcand/He_pop_EUcand)

# Plot these metrics against sample sizes

He.df <- as.data.frame(He_pop)
He.df$grouping <- rownames(He.df)
He.df <- inner_join(He.df, key_df, by = "grouping")
He.df$history <- factor(He.df$history, levels = c("Turkey", "Greece", "PNW", "Primary", "P/S", "S/T", "S/T/Q", "T/Q"))

He.cand.df <- as.data.frame(He_pop_cand)
He.cand.df$grouping <- rownames(He.cand.df)
He.cand.df <- inner_join(He.cand.df, key_df, by = "grouping")
He.cand.df$history <- factor(He.cand.df$history, levels = c("Turkey", "Greece", "PNW", "Primary", "P/S", "S/T", "S/T/Q", "T/Q"))

He.EUcand.df <- as.data.frame(He_pop_EUcand)
He.EUcand.df$grouping <- rownames(He.EUcand.df)
He.EUcand.df <- inner_join(He.EUcand.df, key_df, by = "grouping")
He.EUcand.df$history <- factor(He.EUcand.df$history, levels = c("Turkey", "Greece",  "PNW", "Primary", "P/S", "S/T", "S/T/Q", "T/Q"))


ggplot() + geom_point(data = He.df, mapping = aes(x = history, y = He_pop, label = grouping)) + 
  geom_point(data = He.cand.df, mapping = aes(x = history, y = He_pop_cand, label = grouping), color = "orange3") + 
  geom_point(data = He.EUcand.df, mapping = aes(x = history, y = He_pop_EUcand, label = grouping), color = "skyblue1") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Population Grouping") + ylab("Expected Heterozygosity")

##

Ho.df <- as.data.frame(Ho_pop)
Ho.df$grouping <- rownames(Ho.df)
Ho.df <- inner_join(Ho.df, key_df, by = "grouping")
```

## Allelic Richness

```{r}
# As CA Groups


# Using hierfstat: 
# Non-candidates 
ar.hf <- hierfstat::allelic.richness(EUVI.notCand.gid)
ar.mean <- as.data.frame(colMeans(ar.hf$Ar, na.rm = T))
ar.mean$pop <- rownames(ar.mean)
ar.mean.se <- reshape2::melt(ar.hf$Ar) %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  summarize(se = sd(value)/sqrt(length(value)))
ar.mean$se <- ar.mean.se$se

colnames(ar.mean) <- c("AR", "grouping", "SE")
ar.mean.join <- inner_join(key_df, ar.mean)

# WUS pRDA candidates
ar.cand <- allelic.richness(EUVI.pRDA.cand.gid)
ar.cand.mean <- as.data.frame(colMeans(ar.cand$Ar, na.rm = T))
ar.cand.mean$pop <- rownames(ar.cand.mean)
ar.cand.mean$se <- reshape2::melt(ar.cand$Ar) %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  summarize(se = sd(value, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(value)))
  
colnames(ar.cand.mean) <- c("AR", "grouping", "sd")
ar.cand.mean.join <- inner_join(key_df, ar.cand.mean)

# EU pRDA candidates
ar.EUcand <- allelic.richness(EUVI.EUpRDA.cand.gid)
ar.EUcand.mean <- as.data.frame(colMeans(ar.EUcand$Ar, na.rm = T))
ar.EUcand.mean$pop <- rownames(ar.EUcand.mean)
ar.EUcand.mean$se <- reshape2::melt(ar.EUcand$Ar) %>% 
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  summarize(se = sd(value, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(value)))
  
colnames(ar.EUcand.mean) <- c("AR", "grouping", "sd")
ar.EUcand.mean.join <- inner_join(key_df, ar.EUcand.mean)
```

## Nucleotide Diversity 

Per-site nucleotide diversity was estimated for each population in vcftools. 

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)


filelist = list.files(path = "./groups-pi/", pattern = "pRDA.sites.pi", full.names = T)
datafr <- lapply(filelist, FUN=read.table, header = T)
#datafr2<- lapply(datafr, FUN=rownames_to_column)

func <- function(...) {
  df1 = list(...)[[1]]
  df2 = list(...)[[2]]
  col1 = colnames(df1)[1]
  col2 = colnames(df2)[1]
  xxx = dplyr::full_join(..., by = c("POS", "CHROM"))
  return(xxx)
}

t <- Reduce( func, datafr)
t2 <- as.data.frame(colMeans(t, na.rm = T))

rownames(t2) <- c("CHROM", "POS", filelist)
t2$pi <- t2$`colMeans(t, na.rm = T)`
t2$pop <- rownames(t2)

t2$pop<- gsub("./pi//","",t2$pop)
t2$pop <- gsub(".samples.sites.pi","", t2$pop)

pi_df <- filter(t2, pop != "CHROM" & pop != "POS") %>% 
  select(pi, pop)

pi_df$grouping <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F1", "F2", "G1", "G2", "Greece", "H", "I1", "I2", "ID", "OR", "Primary","Turkey", "WA")

pi_site_hist <- inner_join(pi_df, key_df)

t3 <- as.data.frame(lapply(t, se))
colnames(t3) <- c("CHROM", "POS", filelist)


filelist = list.files(path = "./groups-pi/", pattern = "nonCand.sites.pi", full.names = T)
datafr <- lapply(filelist, FUN=read.table, header = T)
#datafr2<- lapply(datafr, FUN=rownames_to_column)

func <- function(...) {
  df1 = list(...)[[1]]
  df2 = list(...)[[2]]
  col1 = colnames(df1)[1]
  col2 = colnames(df2)[1]
  xxx = dplyr::full_join(..., by = c("POS", "CHROM"))
  return(xxx)
}

t <- Reduce( func, datafr)
t2 <- as.data.frame(colMeans(t, na.rm = T))

rownames(t2) <- c("CHROM", "POS", filelist)
t2$pi <- t2$`colMeans(t, na.rm = T)`
t2$pop <- rownames(t2)

t2$pop<- gsub("./pi//","",t2$pop)
t2$pop <- gsub(".samples.sites.pi","", t2$pop)

pi_df <- filter(t2, pop != "CHROM" & pop != "POS") %>% 
  select(pi, pop)

pi_df$grouping <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F1", "F2", "G1", "G2", "Greece", "H", "I1", "I2", "ID", "OR", "Primary","Turkey", "WA")

pi_nonCand_site_hist <- inner_join(pi_df, key_df)

t3 <- as.data.frame(lapply(t, se))
colnames(t3) <- c("CHROM", "POS", filelist)

filelist = list.files(path = "./groups-pi/", pattern = "pRDA.EU.sites.pi", full.names = T)
datafr <- lapply(filelist, FUN=read.table, header = T)
#datafr2<- lapply(datafr, FUN=rownames_to_column)

func <- function(...) {
  df1 = list(...)[[1]]
  df2 = list(...)[[2]]
  col1 = colnames(df1)[1]
  col2 = colnames(df2)[1]
  xxx = dplyr::full_join(..., by = c("POS", "CHROM"))

t <- Reduce( func, datafr)

pi_EUCand_site_hist <- inner_join(pi_df, key_df)

pi_EUCand_site_hist$history <- factor(pi_EUCand_site_hist$history, levels= c("Turkey", "Greece", "Primary", "P/S", "S/T", "S/T/Q", "T/Q"))
```
